ābhā.p: [Ā+bhā+kvi] (thī) CL=7 [Ābhuso bhātīti ābhā. Dhāna, ṭī.64] (1) Glow (or) Radiance, Radiance. (Ti) (2) perfected/fulfilled with glow and radiance, It is shine. (3) It is called 'ābha' due to complete/fulfill with radiance. have named  parittābha, appamāṇābha, ābhassara. Brahma (Brahma who is in second levels of Jhana realm).
pn: Ābhā. A generic name for Devas distinguished for their brilliance, such as the Parittābhā and the Āppamāṇābhā. MN.iii.102; MN-a.ii.902.
